POST /auth/register.summary: Register a STUDENT or PARENT account
POST /auth/register.description: Creates an unverified account and emails a verification token (valid 24h). STUDENT accounts also need a club-created student profile (via invite-code linking or admin creation) before profile data appears. The response is identical for new and already-registered emails (anti-enumeration) — an existing address receives a "you already registered" mail instead. Password policy: 8+ chars, letters and digits, must not contain the email.

email.description: Email the verification mail was sent to.

requiresVerification.description: Always true: the account is unusable until verified.

POST /auth/login.description: Verifies credentials and issues a session (access + refresh token). When TOTP MFA is enrolled the response instead carries a short-lived mfaToken — complete login via POST /auth/mfa/login-verify. Every failure (unknown email, wrong password, locked, deactivated, unverified) answers the same 401 message. Per-account lockout after repeated failures; strict per-IP throttle on the whole auth surface.

mfaRequired.description: A second factor is required before tokens are issued.

mfaToken.description: Short-lived token; send it with POST /auth/mfa/login-verify.

POST /auth/refresh-token.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new session pair; the presented token is consumed (rotation). Reusing an already-consumed token is treated as theft: every session of the user is revoked and security mail is sent.

POST /auth/verify-email.description: Consumes the single-use token from the verification mail (24h TTL) and marks the address verified. Verified accounts can log in.

emailVerified.description: Constant true after a successful verification.

POST /auth/resend-verification.description: Sends the verification mail again. Always answers the same body whether or not the address exists (anti-enumeration); per-account mail budget limits abuse.

POST /auth/forgot-password.description: Emails a reset token (15 min TTL). Always answers the same body regardless of account existence (anti-enumeration); per-account mail budget limits abuse.

POST /auth/reset-password.summary: Reset the password with the emailed token
POST /auth/reset-password.description: Consumes the single-use reset token and replaces the password. All existing sessions and refresh tokens are revoked.

POST /auth/logout.description: Revokes the presented session: refresh tokens die immediately, the access token is denylisted until it expires.

POST /auth/logout-all.description: Revokes all sessions and refresh tokens of the account and bumps the token version so every outstanding access token dies.

GET /auth/sessions.description: The account’s currently active (non-revoked, unexpired) sessions, newest activity first — the "logged in devices" screen.

DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}.description: Revokes one of the caller’s own sessions (e.g. a lost device). Foreign or unknown session ids answer 401.

GET /auth/me.description: The authenticated account’s id, email, role, verification and MFA status — the "who am I" call for session bootstrap.

DELETE /auth/me.description: REST-delete alias of POST /auth/deactivate with identical semantics and body, so clients can use the idiomatic verb.

GET /auth/me/audit-log.description: Paginated security events of the calling account (logins, password changes, MFA, token reuse, ...), newest first — the "recent activity" screen.

POST /auth/change-password.description: Re-authenticates with the current password (plus TOTP code when MFA is on), applies the password policy, revokes all sessions and bumps the token version.

POST /auth/change-email/request.description: Re-authenticates with the current password and emails a confirmation token (24h TTL) to the NEW address. The address is not changed until POST /auth/change-email/confirm consumes it.

POST /auth/change-email/confirm.description: Consumes the emailed token and switches the account email. Single-use; conflicting tokens fail with the uniform invalid-token error.

POST /auth/deactivate.description: Re-authenticates (password + TOTP when enrolled), soft-deletes the account, revokes all sessions and blocks future logins. Financial history is retained (soft deletion).

POST /auth/mfa/login-verify.description: Exchanges the mfaToken from POST /auth/login (mfaRequired=true) plus a TOTP code (or an 8-char recovery code) for a full session. Failure budget: 5 wrong codes per 5 minutes lock the second factor out temporarily.

mfaRequired.description: Constant false: tokens are issued in the same response.

GET /auth/mfa/methods.description: Which second factors are enrolled on the account (currently only TOTP). Used to render account-security UI.

POST /auth/mfa/totp/enable.description: Generates a TOTP secret (stored sealed) and returns the otpauth URL plus a QR data URL for the authenticator app. Enrollment is only ACTIVE after POST /auth/mfa/totp/verify succeeds; until then login does not require MFA.

qrDataUrl.description: PNG data URL of the QR code to scan.

POST /auth/mfa/totp/verify.description: Confirms the pending enrollment with the first valid code. On success returns the ONE-TIME recovery codes (shown exactly once, store them) and MFA becomes mandatory for this account’s logins.

recoveryCodes.description: Single-use 8-character recovery codes; only hashes are stored.

POST /auth/mfa/totp/validate.description: Inline second-factor confirmation for sensitive screens (step-up). Shares the failure budget with all other TOTP surfaces (5 fails / 5 minutes).

POST /auth/mfa/totp/disable.description: Re-authenticates with password + current TOTP code, removes the enrollment and revokes all sessions.

GET /auth/mfa/totp/recovery-codes.description: How many single-use recovery codes are still unused — the "codes left" indicator.

GET /users.description:
Paginated account directory, newest first, with role filter and case-insensitive email search. Never includes credential material.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the email.

POST /users.description:
Creates a verified account of any role — the supported path for INSTRUCTOR/ADMIN staff accounts. The initial password must satisfy the policy and is handed to the user out of band. Duplicate emails answer 409.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

PATCH /users/{id}.description:
Changes role, activation or password. Any trust-affecting change (role change, deactivation, new password) revokes all sessions and refresh tokens immediately. Admins cannot change their own role or deactivate themselves.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

DELETE /users/{id}.description:
Soft-deletes the account (deletedAt + isActive=false) and revokes all sessions. Self-deactivation is refused (400). Invoices and other history are retained.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /admin/audit-log.description:
Paginated audit trail of every recorded event (auth, billing, admin actions, ...), filterable by acting user and event name, newest first.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Filter by event name, e.g. login, user_updated.

GET /invoices.description:
Role-scoped: ADMIN everything (optionally filtered by studentId), STUDENT their own, PARENT their linked children’s. INSTRUCTOR has no financial surface. Filters by status and type; newest first. Detail endpoint includes line items.

**Roles:** ADMIN, STUDENT, PARENT.

parameters.name: studentId
parameters.description: ADMIN-only filter by student; other roles are always scoped to themselves.

POST /invoices.description:
Creates an invoice from explicit line items. TUITION invoices require periodMonth/periodYear (they drive the monthly idempotency key); other types forbid them. total = subtotal − manual discount − discount-code discount, and cannot go below 0 (400). An active discount code is resolved and burned-in at creation time; the invoice number is sequential and unique. The student’s linked account receives an in-app + email notification in the same transaction.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /invoices/{id}.description: Full invoice with line items, ownership-guard scoped. Instructors never see invoices (uniform 404).

POST /admin/billing/generate-monthly.description:
Generates one TUITION invoice per ACTIVE student per period from the configured tuition rates — a student enrolled in two selected classes gets one invoice with two line items. Idempotent per (student, period): rerunning skips existing invoices. Classes without a configured rate are reported in classesSkipped. Due date: 10th of the period.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

skippedExisting.description: Student/period pairs skipped because the period invoice already exists (idempotent rerun).

dueDate.description: Due date stamped on the created invoices (10th of the period).

GET /admin/reports/revenue.description:
Revenue by month and settlement channel over SUCCESS payments inside the window, plus the grand total. Refunded/disputed money is excluded; refunding moves it out of the window sum on the next call.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

grandTotal.description: Revenue across all rows and gateways (VND).

GET /admin/reports/tuition.description:
For one period: invoice counts and sums per status, plus the actually settled (SUCCESS payments) amount — the receivables picture of the monthly close.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

totalVnd.description: Sum of invoice totals in the status (VND).

collectedVnd.description: Actually settled (SUCCESS payments) for the period (VND).

GET /admin/billing/settings.description:
The two billing configuration keys: the tuition_rates map (classId → VND/month) and the receiving bank account (null until configured).

**Roles:** ADMIN.

tuitionRates.description: Map of classId → monthly tuition in VND (drives the monthly tuition close).

bankAccount.description: Receiving account for QR payments (null until configured).

name.example: CONG TY TNHH VOVINAM ANH QUAN

owner_type.description: Account owner type; only BUSINESS may collect fees.

PUT /admin/billing/settings/tuition-rate.description:
Replaces the whole tuition_rates map. Unknown class ids and duplicate entries in the payload are rejected. Only future invoice runs use the new rates — existing invoices keep their stored amounts.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

tuitionRates.description: Map of classId → monthly tuition in VND (drives the monthly tuition close).

bankAccount.description: Receiving account for QR payments (null until configured).

name.example: CONG TY TNHH VOVINAM ANH QUAN

owner_type.description: Account owner type; only BUSINESS may collect fees.

PUT /admin/billing/settings/bank-account.description:
Configures the account QR payments settle into. Only BUSINESS owner type is accepted (fee collection rule). QR creation fails with 409 until this is set.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

tuitionRates.description: Map of classId → monthly tuition in VND (drives the monthly tuition close).

bankAccount.description: Receiving account for QR payments (null until configured).

name.example: CONG TY TNHH VOVINAM ANH QUAN

owner_type.description: Account owner type; only BUSINESS may collect fees.

GET /discounts.description:
Paginated discount code catalog, newest first.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /discounts.description:
Creates a code. Exactly ONE of percentOff/amountOff must be set (XOR, validated); validUntil must be after validFrom. Codes are unique case-insensitively (stored uppercase); duplicates answer 409.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

PATCH /discounts/{id}.description:
Edits description, expiry or active flag. The percent/amount type is immutable — retire the code and create a new one instead.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

DELETE /discounts/{id}.description:
Hard-deletes the code (configuration, not a financial record). Invoices already issued keep their burned-in discount amount.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /payments/qr/{invoiceId}.summary: Start a QR payment for an invoice
POST /payments/qr/{invoiceId}.description:
Creates a PENDING payment transaction with a unique order reference and gateway checkout/QR payload (30-minute QR expiry). Replacement requests are serialized per invoice; each supersedes older pending attempts. Ownership guard: ADMIN/STUDENT own, PARENT linked children. Only UNPAID/OVERDUE invoices are payable (409); the receiving bank account must be configured (409). Instructors have no money surface.

**Roles:** ADMIN, STUDENT, PARENT.

orderRef.description: Transfer-content reference the gateway reports back.

amount.description: Amount to pay (VND) — equals the invoice total.

checkoutUrl.description: Gateway-hosted payment page (null for the simulated gateway).

qrCodeDataUrl.description: PNG data URL of the QR when the gateway provides one.

POST /payments/webhook/{provider}.description: PUBLIC webhook authenticated by HMAC over the RAW body. Invalid signatures return 401. Unknown orders and signed malformed events are 200 no-ops. Database/transaction failures return 5xx so the provider can retry; claims and settlement roll back together. All receipt transitions serialize per invoice. Duplicate transaction IDs are idempotent. Amount mismatches, expired QR receipts and receipts for cancelled/refunded invoices become DISPUTED for manual reconciliation. Excess settlement is flagged; it never silently increases accepted SUCCESS totals beyond the invoice total.

flagged.description: True when a received transfer requires reconciliation and is marked DISPUTED.

overpaid.description: True when accepted settlements would exceed the invoice total.

totalSettled.description: Attempted aggregate settled amount when overpayment is detected (VND).

POST /payments/{invoiceId}/confirm-cash.description:
Marks the invoice PAID and records a CASH settlement in one transaction; the invoice-status claim makes double confirmation impossible (second call → 409). Only UNPAID/OVERDUE invoices qualify.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

PATCH /payments/{id}.description:
Records an externally completed refund or flags a successful receipt for review. This API does not initiate a bank transfer. SUCCESS receipts may be marked REFUNDED or DISPUTED; DISPUTED receipts may be marked REFUNDED. Other transitions return 409. Invoice status is recomputed under the same invoice lock; history is retained and webhook replay cannot change a REFUNDED receipt.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /payments.description:
All settlement attempts of one invoice, newest first, ownership-guard scoped (ADMIN/STUDENT own, PARENT linked).

**Roles:** ADMIN, STUDENT, PARENT.

GET /students/me.description:
The profile linked to the calling STUDENT account (contact fields included). 404 until the club has created/approved the profile.

**Roles:** STUDENT.

PATCH /students/me.description:
Self-service edit of contact fields only (phone, address, emergency contact, medical notes). Identity fields (name, dob, gender), belt and status stay admin-managed.

**Roles:** STUDENT.

GET /students.description:
ADMIN sees the whole non-deleted directory; INSTRUCTOR sees only students currently enrolled in their own classes (a foreign classId filter yields an empty list, never an error). Fields: instructors receive identity/belt/medical only; admin receives contacts as well.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match on the full name (min 2 chars).

parameters.name: classId
parameters.description: Limit to students currently enrolled in this class.

POST /students.description:
Creates the profile (ACTIVE) and its first single-use parent invite code. `linkedUserEmail` attaches the profile to an existing verified STUDENT account. The invite code is returned exactly once here — hand it to the parent.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /students/{id}.description: Role-scoped through the ownership guard: STUDENT sees their own profile, PARENT verified-linked children, INSTRUCTOR students currently enrolled in classes they teach (contacts hidden), ADMIN everyone. Foreign/unknown ids answer the uniform 404.

PATCH /students/{id}.description:
Full-field admin edit: identity, contacts, medical notes, belt rank and lifecycle status (e.g. approving a PENDING profile to ACTIVE).

**Roles:** ADMIN.

DELETE /students/{id}.description:
Marks the profile deleted and deactivates the linked account. Invoices and attendance history are retained (financial integrity); the profile disappears from every directory query. Idempotent-per-state: repeating answers 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /students/{id}/invite-code.description:
Replaces the single-use invite code. The old code stops working immediately (e.g. a code leaked or mistyped too often). Returns the new code — hand it to the parent.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /notifications/me.description: The caller’s in-app notifications (and email outbox rows), newest first. Always scoped to the caller; nothing foreign is addressable.

POST /admin/notifications/flush.description:
Runs one in-process worker pass synchronously (ops/diagnostics helper). Normally the background worker drains the outbox automatically.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

PATCH /notifications/{id}/read.description: Marks one of the caller’s notifications read. Idempotent: re-reading returns the row with its readAt unchanged; foreign/unknown ids answer the uniform 404.

GET /classes.description: Paginated class catalog with weekly schedules; every authenticated role can read it (students need it to see what to attend). Filter by lifecycle status.

POST /classes.description:
Creates a class taught by an active INSTRUCTOR-role user; assigning anyone else answers 404/400.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /classes/{id}.description: One class with schedules and the current number of active enrollments (the "how full is it" field).

PATCH /classes/{id}.description:
Renames, moves, re-staffs, resizes or pauses/archives a class. Capacity cannot drop below the current active enrollments (409). PAUSED/ARCHIVED classes accept no new sessions or enrollments; history stays readable.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /classes/{id}/schedules.description:
Adds a recurring slot (weekday + HH:MM window + validity range). Start must be before end; the effective range must be ordered.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

DELETE /classes/{id}/schedules/{schedule.description:
Deletes one schedule slot of the class. Foreign/unknown slot ids answer the uniform 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /enrollments.description:
Enrolls an ACTIVE student into an ACTIVE class. Serialized per class (row lock), so concurrent enrollments cannot overbook capacity. Rules enforced: no duplicate open enrollment, one enrollment per (student, class, day) — rejoining is allowed on a later day, class capacity must have room. Each violation answers a distinct 409.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /enrollments.description:
Paginated enrollment ledger (newest first), filterable by class and/or student. Includes past (left) enrollments for history screens.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

DELETE /enrollments/{id}.description:
Soft leave: sets leftAt so attendance history, reports and the FK chain survive. Re-enrollment later is a new row.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /attendance-sessions.description:
Opens a session for one class date. ADMIN for any class; INSTRUCTOR only for classes they teach (foreign class → 404) and the teacher of record defaults to the class instructor. One session per class per date (409 on duplicate); PAUSED/ARCHIVED classes refuse new sessions (409).

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

POST /attendance-sessions/{id}/records.description:
Creates or overwrites the record of every listed student in one atomic batch (upsert keyed by session+student). Every student must be currently enrolled in the session class and appear at most once; sessions of foreign classes answer 404. Corrections after the fact simply resend the affected students.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

GET /attendance-sessions/{id}/records.description:
All marked students of one session (student names included). ADMIN anywhere; INSTRUCTOR only their own classes (foreign session → 404).

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

GET /students/{id}/attendance.description: Paginated attendance records (newest session first) with class names. Scoped by the ownership guard: own (STUDENT), linked children (PARENT), currently taught students (INSTRUCTOR), all (ADMIN); optional date window.

GET /attendance/summary.summary: Monthly attendance summary of a student
GET /attendance/summary.description: PRESENT/LATE/ABSENT/EXCUSED counts for one student and month bucket, ownership-guard scoped.

GET /admin/reports/attendance.description:
Per-class session counts and status totals for one month. ADMIN sees the whole club; INSTRUCTOR only classes they teach (archived classes excluded). Empty result when nothing was held.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

attendanceRate.description: (present + late) / marked × 100, rounded to 0.1; null when nothing was marked.

GET /belt-ranks.description: The rank catalog ordered by orderIndex (the promotion ladder). Readable by every authenticated role.

POST /belt-ranks.description:
Adds a rung to the ladder. code and orderIndex are unique (distinct 409 messages tell which one collided).

**Roles:** ADMIN.

PATCH /belt-ranks/{id}.description:
Renames/reorders/deactivates a rank. Deactivated ranks can no longer be exam or proposal targets. id is the integer BeltRank id.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

GET /admin/reports/belts.description:
Active students grouped by current rank plus the unranked count. ADMIN sees the club; INSTRUCTOR only students currently enrolled in classes they teach.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

students.description: Active students currently holding the rank.

unrankedStudents.description: Active students without a belt rank yet.

GET /belt-exams.description: Paginated exam catalog (soonest first) with target rank and fee — students browse it to register. Filter by lifecycle status.

POST /belt-exams.description:
Creates an exam in DRAFT. The target rank must exist and be active; the registration deadline must not be after the exam date. Exam code is generated as EXAM-<year>-NN when omitted.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

GET /belt-exams/{id}.description: One exam with its target rank, fee and the current number of active registrations.

PATCH /belt-exams/{id}.description:
Edits metadata or moves the lifecycle (typically DRAFT → OPEN → CLOSED → COMPLETED, or CANCELLED). Registration requires OPEN and an unpassed deadline; deadline must stay ordered against the exam date.

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /belt-exams/{id}/register.summary: Register a student for an exam
POST /belt-exams/{id}/register.description:
STUDENT registers themselves; PARENT a verified-linked child (ownership guard). Atomically (transaction + exam row lock) it checks: exam OPEN, deadline unpassed, student ACTIVE, target rank strictly above the student’s current rank, capacity, and no duplicate registration — then creates the registration AND its EXAM_FEE invoice together. Distinct 409 messages name the violated rule.

**Roles:** STUDENT, PARENT.

status.description: Registration status; PENDING until a result is recorded.

currentRankId.description: Rank the student held at registration time.

invoice.description: The EXAM_FEE invoice issued atomically with the registration.

GET /exam-registrations.description: Paginated belt history (matrix row 17): every exam registration of one student with ranks and results, newest exam first. The RESULT_PASS rows in order ARE the promotion timeline. Ownership-guard scoped for every role; `studentId` is required.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

resultRecordedAt.description: When the result was recorded (registration row update time).

POST /exam-registrations/{id}/result.description:
ADMIN/INSTRUCTOR record the outcome. RESULT_PASS promotes the student to the exam’s target rank (re-validated at result time so a pass can never move a belt down); RESULT_FAIL leaves the belt untouched. Results are final: a second result answers 409. ADMIN may attribute another examiner; instructors may only record results of students currently enrolled in their own classes (foreign ids → 404).

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

examinerId.description: User id of the examiner of record.

POST /parents/link.summary: Link a child by invite code (PARENT)
POST /parents/link.description:
Claims the single-use invite code and creates a VERIFIED parent-student link. The code is rotated away in the same transaction, so of two parents racing the same code exactly one wins (the loser sees the uniform 404). Linking the same child twice answers 409.

**Roles:** PARENT.

GET /parents/me/children.description:
The verified-linked, non-deleted student profiles of the calling parent — the family screen.

**Roles:** PARENT.

DELETE /parents/links/{studentId}.description:
Removes a link. Verified links (created via invite code) can only be removed by the club — a self-unlink attempt answers 409 by design. Access to the child’s data ends immediately after an unlink.

**Roles:** PARENT.

POST /consent.description: Grants one purpose for the caller, or — with studentId — for a verified-linked MINOR (the acting parent is recorded). Idempotent: an already-active purpose returns the existing row with alreadyActive=true. Append-only: revoking and re-granting adds a new history row. Parents cannot consent for adults; students without an account cannot be proxied (400).

POST /consent/revoke.description: Stamps the active row of one purpose as revoked (history stays). 404 when the purpose was never granted or is already revoked.

GET /consent/me.description: The caller’s consent rows (grants and revocations), newest first — the consent audit screen.

GET /announcements.description: Audience-scoped feed, newest first. ALL announcements reach everyone; CLASS announcements only users related to the class (instructor, enrolled students, verified-linked parents). ADMIN sees everything.

POST /announcements.description:
ADMIN may post club-wide (ALL) or class-scoped; INSTRUCTOR only CLASS announcements for classes they teach (club-wide attempts answer 403, foreign classes 404). audience=ALL forbids classId; audience=CLASS requires it.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

PATCH /announcements/{id}.description:
ADMIN edits anything; INSTRUCTOR only their own announcements and only within CLASS audience of classes they teach (foreign/foreign-authored → 404). The effective audience/class pair must stay consistent (switching to ALL drops the class target).

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

DELETE /announcements/{id}.description:
ADMIN deletes anything; INSTRUCTOR only their own (foreign → uniform 404).

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

POST /leave-requests.description:
STUDENT (self) or PARENT (linked child) asks to miss one class session. The student must be actively enrolled (409 otherwise); the date must be today or later (400) and one request per (student, class, date) (409). Foreign students answer the uniform 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN, STUDENT, PARENT.

GET /leave-requests.description:
Role-scoped: ADMIN all, INSTRUCTOR requests of their own classes, STUDENT/PARENT their own. Filters by status/class/student; newest first.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR, STUDENT, PARENT.

POST /leave-requests/{id}/review.description:
The class instructor (or an ADMIN) approves/rejects a PENDING request; only PENDING can be reviewed (409 after finality). Instructors reviewing a foreign class request get the uniform 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

POST /leave-requests/{id}/cancel.description:
The requester (or an ADMIN) cancels a PENDING request; final states cannot be cancelled (409). Non-owner cancellations answer the uniform 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN, STUDENT, PARENT.

DELETE /leave-requests/{id}.description:
Hard-deletes a request row (cleanup tool; workflow states should be driven through review/cancel).

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /promotion-proposals.description:
INSTRUCTOR (own-class students) or ADMIN proposes a student for a higher rank. The proposed rank must be active and strictly above the current one (409), and the student may not already have an open proposal (409). Advisory only: approval never changes the belt — only an exam RESULT_PASS does.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

GET /promotion-proposals.description:
Role-scoped: ADMIN all, INSTRUCTOR own-class students, STUDENT/PARENT their own. Filter by status/student; newest first.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR, STUDENT, PARENT.

PATCH /promotion-proposals/{id}.description:
The author (or an ADMIN) edits the note while the proposal is still PENDING; final proposals are immutable (409), foreign ones 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

POST /promotion-proposals/{id}/review.description:
The master (ADMIN persona) approves or rejects a PENDING proposal. Approval is bookkeeping only — it NEVER moves the belt; scheduling the exam is the next organizational step. Instructors cannot review (uniform 404), only PENDING can be reviewed (409).

**Roles:** ADMIN.

POST /evaluations.description:
INSTRUCTOR/ADMIN record a 1..10 rating with optional comment (own-class students for instructors; ownership guard). With periodMonth+periodYear the evaluation is unique per (author, student, period) — a duplicate answers 409; omit the period for unbound evaluations.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

GET /evaluations.description: Paginated evaluations of one student, newest first, ownership-guard scoped (student self, linked parents, instructors, admin). `studentId` is required.

PATCH /evaluations/{id}.description:
The author (or an ADMIN) corrects rating/comment. Foreign-authored evaluations answer the uniform 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

DELETE /evaluations/{id}.description:
The author (or an ADMIN) removes a mistaken evaluation; foreign ones answer the uniform 404.

**Roles:** ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR.

email.description: Account email; doubles as the login name and verification target.

password.description: Account password. Policy: at least 8 characters with letters and digits, and it must not contain the email.

role.description: Self-service roles only. Staff roles (INSTRUCTOR, ADMIN) are created by an admin through the backoffice.

fullName.description: Full display name of the account holder.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth (ISO 8601 date). Minors are registered by the club, never self-serve.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by login / mfa login-verify / refresh-token. Rotated on every use.

token.description: Email verification token from the verification link (valid 24 hours).

email.description: Account email the mail should be sent to.

token.description: Password reset token from the email link (valid 15 minutes).

password.description: New password. Policy: at least 8 characters with letters and digits.

newPassword.description: Replacement password (policy-validated). Revokes all other sessions.

code.description: Current TOTP code; required when MFA is enabled on the account.

newEmail.description: New email address. The change only applies after the emailed confirmation token is used.

token.description: Email-change confirmation token from the email sent to the NEW address.

password.description: Current password (re-authentication for a sensitive operation).

code.description: Current TOTP code; required when MFA is enabled on the account.

mfaToken.description: Short-lived mfaToken returned by POST /auth/login when mfaRequired is true.

code.description: 6-digit TOTP code from the authenticator app (or an 8-character recovery code where accepted).
Current TOTP code from the authenticator app.

password.description: Initial password (policy-validated). The admin hands it to the user out of band.

role.description: Role of the new account; creating INSTRUCTOR/ADMIN accounts is the supported staff path.

fullName.description: Optional display name stored on the linked student profile, not on the account.

role.description: New role. Changing it revokes all sessions and bumps the password version immediately.

isActive.description: Deactivating (false) revokes all sessions; reactivation does not restore them.

newPassword.description: Admin-set replacement password (policy-validated); revokes all sessions.

unitAmount.description: Unit price in VND (integer). Each quantity × unitAmount and the invoice subtotal must not exceed 2147483647 VND; exceeding either bound returns 400.

studentId.description: StudentProfile id the invoice is issued to.

type.description: Invoice type. TUITION requires periodMonth/periodYear and is idempotent per (student, period); other types forbid them.

items.description: Line items (1..50). The sum of line amounts must not exceed 2147483647 VND.

discount.description: Manual discount in VND; total = subtotal − discount − code discount; total ≥ 0.

dueDate.description: Payment due date (ISO 8601); defaults to 14 days from now.

note.description: Free-text note shown on the invoice.

periodMonth.description: Billing period month (1..12); required for TUITION, forbidden otherwise.

periodYear.description: Billing period year (2000..2100); required for TUITION, forbidden otherwise.

discountCode.description: Active discount code resolved at creation time; its discount is added to any manual discount.

classIds.description: Classes to close tuition for; every class needs a configured tuition rate.

classId.description: Class id the rate applies to (must exist).

rates.description: Replaces the whole stored tuition_rates map; unknown class ids are rejected and duplicates within the list fail.

name.example: CONG TY TNHH VOVINAM ANH QUAN

ownerType.description: Plan section 10: fee collection only through the legal entity account (BUSINESS).

bankAccount.description: Receiving account for QR payments; must be the legal entity account.

code.description: Code customers quote (unique, case-insensitive; stored uppercase).

percentOff.description: Percent discount (1..100). Set exactly ONE of percentOff/amountOff.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount in VND (integer ≥ 1000). Set exactly ONE of percentOff/amountOff.

validUntil.description: Last valid moment (ISO 8601 date-time); must be after validFrom.

isActive.description: Deactivate without deleting; inactive codes are refused at invoice time.

note.description: Note recorded with the cash payment (who paid, receipt number, ...).

status.description: REFUNDED records an externally completed refund; this API does not initiate a bank transfer. SUCCESS or DISPUTED receipts may be refunded. Only SUCCESS receipts may be marked DISPUTED.

note.description: Reason recorded in the audit trail.

medicalNotes.description: Medical notes visible to instructors for safety.
Medical notes the instructors must know (injuries, asthma, ...). Shown to instructors for safety.
medicalNotes.example: Mild asthma; inhaler in gym bag

currentBeltRankId.description: BeltRank id the student currently holds; omit for an unranked beginner.

linkedUserEmail.description: Links the profile to an existing verified STUDENT account (e.g. an adult self-registration awaiting approval). The account must have no profile yet.

medicalNotes.description: Medical notes the instructors must know (injuries, asthma, ...).
medicalNotes.example: Mild asthma; inhaler in gym bag

currentBeltRankId.description: BeltRank id the student currently holds.

status.description: Lifecycle status. PENDING = awaiting club approval, ACTIVE = training, PAUSED = temporarily away, LEFT = departed.

instructorId.description: User id of the assigned instructor; must be an active user with the INSTRUCTOR role.

capacity.description: Maximum number of simultaneously active enrollments (1..500).

instructorId.description: User id of the new instructor (must have the INSTRUCTOR role).

capacity.description: New capacity; cannot be lower than the current number of active enrollments.

status.description: Lifecycle status. PAUSED/ARCHIVED block new sessions and enrollments; history stays readable.

weekday.description: Day of week, 0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday (Postgres DOW convention).

endTime.description: End time HH:MM (24h); must be after the start time.

effectiveFrom.description: First date the slot applies (ISO 8601 date).

effectiveTo.description: Last date the slot applies; omit for an open-ended slot.

studentId.description: StudentProfile id to enroll (must be an ACTIVE profile).

classId.description: Class id to enroll into (must be an ACTIVE class with free capacity).
Class the session belongs to; you must manage that class.

sessionDate.description: Calendar date of the session; one session per class per date (unique).

studentId.description: StudentProfile id; must be currently enrolled in the session class.

status.description: Attendance status for the student in this session.

records.description: One entry per student; each student may appear once, all entries must be enrolled in the class, and the whole batch applies atomically.

code.description: Club code, e.g. LAM_1, VANG_2, DO_6 (unique).

orderIndex.description: Global ordering across all groups; promotion always targets a higher order.

isActive.description: Deactivated ranks cannot be targets of exams or proposals.
Deactivated ranks cannot be targets of exams or proposals.

code.description: Human-readable exam code (e.g. EXAM-2026-03); generated as EXAM-<year>-NN when omitted.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

targetRankId.description: BeltRank id the exam promotes to (must be an active rank).

capacity.description: Maximum number of active registrations; omit for unbounded.

registrationDeadline.description: Registration deadline (ISO 8601); must not be after the exam date. Later registrations are rejected.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

targetRankId.description: BeltRank id the exam promotes to (must be an active rank).

registrationDeadline.description: Registration deadline (ISO 8601); must not be after the exam date.

status.description: Lifecycle: DRAFT → OPEN → CLOSED → COMPLETED, or CANCELLED. Registration requires OPEN.

studentId.description: The student to register; must pass the ownership guard (self for STUDENT, verified link for PARENT).

status.description: RESULT_PASS promotes the student to the exam target rank; RESULT_FAIL leaves the belt unchanged.

resultNote.description: Examiner note recorded with the result.

examinerId.description: ADMIN only: attribute the result to another examiner (user id). Defaults to the caller.

inviteCode.description: The 8-character single-use invite code the club handed to the parent.

studentId.description: A verified PARENT grants on behalf of a linked MINOR (with an account). Omitted when the account holder consents for themselves. Idempotent when an active grant already exists.

purpose.description: Consent purpose to revoke (stamps the active row; history is kept).

studentId.description: Revoke on behalf of a linked minor; omitted for self.

body.example: CLB nghỉ các ngày 1-2/9. Các lớp học lại bình thường từ 3/9.

audience.description: ALL = whole club (ADMIN only); CLASS = one class only. Instructors may only post CLASS.

classId.description: Target class for audience=CLASS (required; instructors must teach it); forbidden when audience=ALL.

audience.description: New audience; switching to ALL clears the class target (instructors cannot switch to ALL).

classId.description: New target class; must be consistent with the effective audience.

studentId.description: StudentProfile who will miss the session; ownership guard applies (self/linked child).

classId.description: Class whose session will be missed; the student must be actively enrolled.

sessionDate.description: Date of the class session the student will miss (ISO date); must be today or later, and one request per (student, class, date).

status.description: Review outcome; only PENDING requests can be reviewed.

note.description: Reviewer note recorded with the decision.
note.example: Approved — have fun at the event

studentId.description: StudentProfile to propose; ownership guard applies (instructors: own-class students only).

proposedRankId.description: BeltRank id proposed; must be an active rank strictly above the student current rank. Advisory only — approval never moves the belt.

note.description: Motivation shown to the master when reviewing.
note.example: Consistent training, ready for the exam

note.description: Replacement note; only the author (or an admin) may edit while PENDING.

status.description: Master decision; only PENDING proposals can be reviewed.

studentId.description: StudentProfile being evaluated; ownership guard applies.

classId.description: Optional class context of the evaluation.

periodMonth.description: Period bucket month (1..12); both month and year must be given together.

periodYear.description: Period bucket year (2000..2100); both month and year must be given together.

comment.description: Free-text comment shown to the student and their parents.
comment.example: Strong progress on đòn thế; keep the guard up

currentBeltRankId.description: BeltRank id the student currently holds; null when unranked.

phone.description: Contact phone. Hidden from instructors; present for admin/student/parent views.

emergencyContactName.description: Emergency contact person. Hidden from instructors.

emergencyContactPhone.description: Emergency contact phone. Hidden from instructors.

medicalNotes.description: Medical notes; visible to every role for safety.
medicalNotes.example: Mild asthma; inhaler in gym bag

hasLinkedAccount.description: Whether the profile is linked to a loginable STUDENT account. Absent on instructor views.

inviteCode.description: Single-use parent invite code; returned only by student creation and invite regeneration.

effectiveTo.description: Last date the slot applies; null when open-ended.

instructorId.description: User id of the assigned instructor.

capacity.description: Maximum number of active enrollments; null when unbounded.

activeEnrollmentCount.description: Currently active enrollments; present on the class detail endpoint only.

leftAt.description: When the student left (soft leave); null while enrolled.

sessionDate.description: Session date (one per class per date).

instructorId.description: User id of the teacher of record.

fullName.description: Student full name (present when records are listed).

orderIndex.description: Global ordering; promotion always targets a higher order.

isActive.description: Deactivated ranks cannot be exam/proposal targets.

title.example: Kỳ thi thăng đai vàng — tháng 3

capacity.description: Maximum active registrations; null when unbounded.

registrationDeadline.description: Registration cutoff; later registrations are rejected.

registeredCount.description: Active (non-cancelled) registrations; present on the detail endpoint only.

discount.description: Total discount applied (manual + discount code) (VND integer).

items.description: Line items; present on the detail/create endpoints only.

orderRef.description: Transfer content reference (VV + 8 chars); the webhook reconciles on it.

paidAt.description: When the payment succeeded; null while pending.

expiresAt.description: QR expiry (30 minutes); settlement can still arrive later.

note.description: Cash note or gateway mismatch detail.

percentOff.description: Percent discount when the code is percent-based.

amountOff.description: Fixed discount when the code is amount-based (VND integer).

isActive.description: Inactive codes are refused at invoice time.

payload.description: Template payload (e.g. {message}); render the message from this.

message.example: Invoice INV-2026-0007 (TUITION) issued — total 400000 VND, due 2026-10-15

readAt.description: When the user marked it read; null while unread.

consentedByUserId.description: Acting parent when granted on behalf of a minor; null for self-consent.

alreadyActive.description: True when the grant was idempotent (an active grant already existed).

classId.description: Target class when audience=CLASS; null when club-wide.

sessionDate.description: Session date that will be missed.

note.example: Consistent training, ready for the exam

periodMonth.description: Period bucket month; null when the evaluation is not period-bound.

periodYear.description: Period bucket year; null when the evaluation is not period-bound.

comment.description: Comment shown to the student and their parents.

event.description: Event name, e.g. login, user_updated, invoice_created.

lastActiveAt.description: Last activity seen for the session.

accessToken.description: JWT access token; send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token; rotate via POST /auth/refresh-token.

sessionId.description: Session created by this login (manageable under GET /auth/sessions).

code.description: HTTP status code mirrored in the body.

message.description: Short, generic user-facing error description (validation details are joined into this message; internals stay in the server log).
